embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: AquaFlow: A Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Underwater Streaming Reconstruction
fields.value: Shanghai AI Laboratory (flag) — A monocular 3DGS SLAM system for underwater streaming reconstruction that pairs a subsea-finetuned 3D vision foundation model with a hybrid representation of distance-aware neural Gaussians and a physics-inspired light attenuation and scattering model.

fields.name: Towards Alias-Free 4D Gaussian Representations with Motion-Aware Filtering
fields.value: Samsung R&D Institute India, Bangalore (flag) — Addresses aliasing in 4D Gaussian Splatting of dynamic scenes with a motion-aware 3D smoothing filter whose strength adapts to local motion instead of a static filter.

fields.name: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
fields.value: Tencent; Zeno Zeng — GameXpert-Bench evaluates LLM coding agents on end-to-end game development in three stages: generating a game from a request (97 tasks, 11 genres), diagnosing and fixing injected bugs (100 human-verified tasks) and iterative multi-turn improvement (17 chains), tested by live game interaction and beh

fields.name: Sparse Light Field Sampling Improves Casual 3D and 4D Reconstruction
fields.value: Adobe — Studies why novel-view-synthesis pipelines use monocular input even though consumer devices carry several synchronised cameras, analysing sensor-limited and exposure-limited multi-camera capture for 3D and 4D reconstruction.

fields.name: MultiCube: Compositional 3D Generation With Part-Level Semantic and Spatial Control
fields.value: Roblox — MultiCube generates 3D objects composed of semantically meaningful parts, with explicit control over part semantics (a schema) and spatial layout (bounding boxes) from a text prompt.

fields.name: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
fields.value: Ant Group (flag) — Reconstructs 4D humans from uncalibrated casual monocular video by generating multi-view-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting.

fields.name: Generalized Audio-Driven Synthesis of Precise Drummer Motion
fields.value: Disney Research|Studios (flag) — A diffusion framework that synthesises drumming motion from audio with a dual-objective loss separating body-movement accuracy from stick-tip precision, plus two new metrics, Impact Point Deviation and Percussive Alignment Score; the paper won the Best Paper Award at SCA 2026.
